description: DEF shape, the user's spec as written (2026-10-22): slide only in our defensive third, and with our ball hold a central spot ~15 behind the most advanced teammate. Replaces the slide bullet and the hold-shape bullet; the command list's slide description gets the same restriction.

replace.old: - SLIDE_TACKLE as a last resort when an opponent threatens your goal and is close
replace.new: - SLIDE_TACKLE only in your own defensive third, at an opponent close to your goal. Never slide at a player in the opponent's half, on the sideline, or in the opponent's corner.

replace.old: - Hold your defensive shape; don't chase the ball into the opponent's half
replace.new: - When your team has the ball, MOVE_TO a central spot about 15 units closer to your own goal than your most advanced teammate, with target_y at 0. Do not follow the ball, a wide teammate, or a wide opponent to the wing or the opponent's corner.
distance (float) — only in your own defensive third, opponent close to your goal, never the opponent's wing or corner
